auth.subtitle: Sign in so your data syncs between your phone and iPad
auth.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it, then sign in.
auth.signOutConfirm: We'll upload any pending changes, then sign out. Your data stays in your account.

errors.exists: An account with this email exists, sign in
errors.googleDisabled: Google sign-in isn't enabled in Supabase yet. Use email and password.

auth.migrated: Your on-device data was moved to your account ✓

lowKcal.title: You ate too little {when}
lowKcal.body: You ate only {value} kcal, below {limit}. That's low for a growing athlete — your body needs energy to grow and recover. Try a snack like: {idea}.

lowProtein.title: Protein reminder
lowProtein.body: Protein {when} was {value} g, below {limit} g. Protein helps your muscles recover after boxing.

weightLoss.title: Your weight is dropping fast
weightLoss.body: Your average weight dropped {value} kg in a week — faster than it should at your age. Eat a bit more (e.g. an extra snack daily), and if it continues talk to your parents or a doctor.

ideas: Brown bread sandwich with labneh or cheese
Banana with two spoons of peanut butter
Glass of milk with a handful of nuts

food.title: Food
food.noFavorites: No favorite meals yet. Tap ☆ next to a meal to save it.
food.repeatNote: Each meal is added to the same meal today

library.title: My library
library.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its foods will move to “Snacks”.
library.deleteFoodConfirm: Delete “{name}” from your library? (Past logs are kept)
library.chooseMethod: How do you want to add it?
library.manualDesc: Type the values yourself. Works offline
library.scanDesc: Snap the nutrition label and Gemini fills the fields
library.name: Name
library.kcalMismatch: Note: from protein, carbs and fat the calories should be about {n}. Double-check.
library.scanHint: Photograph the “Nutrition Facts” table clearly. The photo is sent to Gemini only to read the numbers.
library.review: Review the values and fix any number before saving

errors.rateLimit: Gemini's free request limit was reached. Try later or enter values manually.
errors.offline: No internet. Enter the values manually.
errors.notLabel: Couldn't find a nutrition label in the photo. Try a clearer photo or enter manually.
errors.noKey: Label scanning isn't set up (GEMINI_API_KEY missing on the server). Enter manually.
errors.auth: Sign in to use label scanning
errors.generic: Couldn't read the image. Enter the values manually.
errors.invalidValues: Values are missing or don't make sense
errors.busy: Gemini is busy right now (high demand on the free tier). Try again in a minute or enter the values manually.

training.title: Training
training.restDay: Full rest day 😌 Your body grows and recovers while you rest.

weight.title: Weight
weight.label: Weight (kg)
weight.note: Daily weight swings with water and food. The average shows the real trend.
weight.emptyHint: Weigh yourself every morning before eating

stats.title: Stats
stats.compareNote: Averages only count days you logged. Week = last 7 days.

settings.title: Settings
settings.carbsNote: Carbs = what's left after protein (4 kcal/g) and fat (9 kcal/g).
settings.scheduleNote: Days with a workout count as training days automatically; you can change any day manually.
settings.reportNeedsAccount: The automatic report needs an account (Supabase) because it's sent from the server.
settings.importConfirm: Importing replaces all your current data with the file ({n} food logs). Continue?

importErrors.notBackup: This isn't a backup from this app
importErrors.version: The file is from a different version

settings.footer: Your data is stored on your device and synced to your account. Export a backup now and then.
settings.footerLocal: Your data is stored on this device only. Export a backup now and then.

quick.title: Quick add calories
quick.label: Quick add
quick.note: For small things you don't want in your library. Gemini can estimate protein, carbs and fat, and may ask a short question.
quick.stale: You changed the description or calories. Estimate again.

accent.title: Color theme
accent.hint: The logo stays the same; the app's main color follows the theme.

code.sentTo: We sent a verification code to
code.label: Enter the code
code.spam: Didn't get it? Check your Spam folder.

errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then request a new code.
errors.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. If it keeps happening, contact the app admin.
